{{Quote|To ensure the smooth flow of trade between Corellia and the rest of the galaxy.|Corellian Corporate Council's stated goal|<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Corellian Corporate Council}}</ref>}}
The '''Corellia Corporate Council''' was a political policy making coalition with representatives to every government committee on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The planet was dominated by [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] spanning corporate interests that earned trillions of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] with the planetary government claiming significant share of those profits. While their goal was seemingly to promote trade with the galaxy, they actually negotiated in back rooms to limit government commercial regulations and negotiate favorable tax breaks. As a result, every council chairman had been accused of fraud at least once in their career.<ref name="TORC" />
